text:
sara: Heads up — a 2-node TP job is hanging on v2 cluster at step ~1200. No error logs, just stalled. Root span shows an NCCL AllReduce blocking and GPUs idle-waiting.

mike: Which job id / cluster? any logs from runtimed or nccl?

sara: job=2026-03-tp-48, shard-a/b. Pasted the short perf extract I grabbed:

alicia: ```
NCCL INFO: AllReduce op queued, waiting for participant 1
GPU0: matmul_fwd kernel complete @ 0.120s
GPU0: enqueue allreduce @ 0.121s size=1.2MB
GPU1: matmul_fwd delayed until 0.220s (host-side delay)
KV_CACHE: prefix sync triggered full-evict at step 1196 => large payload (~5MB)
Timeline:
  GPU0 compute 0.100-0.121, comm wait 0.121-0.500
  GPU1 compute 0.100-0.220, comm start 0.220-0.500
  => no overlap, allreduce waits for rank1 to hit collective
```

david: That smells like a host-thread stall pushing one rank late into the collective. Any changes to kernel selection or batching recently?

sara: We rolled kernel-picker v2 on canary (deploy 1776080000). It switches to a more aggressive tile size and moved some KV flushes onto the main host thread to avoid async jitter.

mike: We also saw KV cache do a full-evict on prefix updates this morning; it serialises across ranks and causes a synchronous write path. Could explain the 5MB payload and host block.

alicia: Quick repro command for folks who want to collect traces:

```
NCCL_DEBUG=INFO RUNTIME_DEBUG=kv ./run_tp_job --tp 2 --nodes 2 --trace > nccl_trace.log 2>&1
```

alicia: Patch idea: 1) change full-evict to local-only delta, 2) push KV flush off host thread (async io), 3) add backpressure in batching so we don't trigger huge allreduce mid-step.

ci-bot: Build #4521 (kernel-picker v2) deployed to canary hosts at 1776080000; runtime tests: 12/15 OK, 3 flaky (timed out).

david: I reproduced locally with NVPROF + gdb. Host thread is blocked in aio_fsync during the KV write. Kernel-picker v2 seems to call a sync flush path when tile size changed and we hit memory threshold.

sara: Proposed plan: revert kernel-picker autotune on canary (hotfix), add small throttle to KV full-evict (limit to 256KB per step), and add a per-rank stall detector that dumps nccl timeline when collectives stall >200ms. I'll open the PR and link reproducer + perf traces.

mike: Also add a small change to NCCL envs for canary: NCCL_ASYNC=1 and NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=0 to prefer p2p and allow more overlap. Add unit that asserts collectives started within X ms of kernel end.

alicia: I'll attach the perf traces and a minimal repro in the issue once PR is up. Also adding a temporary alert on TP jobs: "tp.collective.stall" for >300ms.

sara: thanks — assigning to eng-runtime oncall for hotfix: @david @alicia please coordinate. I'll create the issue and link traces. :thumbsup:

mike: +1. If we can avoid a full revert and just throttle the KV path, even better.

sara: Agreed. We'll try throttle first, revert if canary still flakes.

alicia: uploading nccl_trace.log and nvprof snapshots to the issue now.

ci-bot: Issue #3487 created: "tp: rendezvous deadlock on kernel-picker v2 + KV full-evict" (links: /issues/3487)

sara: Closing loop — will post follow-up once hotfix is rolled to canary and we have fresh telemetry.
